angles.copy: Big weekend for London music! The Roots Picnic takes over Crystal Palace Bowl this Saturday & Sunday. Expect an unforgettable celebration of music and culture.

angles.copy: Hollywood Vampires bring their rock spectacle to Cardiff Castle on August 14th! Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, Joe Perry – a supergroup not to be missed, even if it is sold out!

moments.title: Jimmy Eat World celebrates 'Bleed American' in Cardiff
